answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission. By the umber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the summit until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the basalt of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
